Version Control

Hàng đợi Bản vá

A series of pending patches or updates managed and applied in order, often used in large-scale code integration and change management systems.

Definition

A series of pending patches or updates managed and applied in order, often used in large-scale code integration and change management systems.

Operational example

Apply each patch in the patch queue to the integration branch only after previous patches have passed all tests.
